title: A deferred CI run is accepted only when the batch's branch holds its sha
why: judge_run can defer to a run for a sha the batch does not hold, so an old main run can stand in for today's.
note: head_checks_run filters runs by head_sha itself. judge_run defers only a cited sha that the batch's branch holds (in base..head), and an old main run is judged as today. Stacked on #1743.
